title: Valve SDD Project
description: Schema for .sdd/<project-name>/project.yaml — the FSM record for a single SDD project.

version.description: Schema version. Used for migration when the schema evolves.

name.description: Kebab-case project name. Must match the directory name under .sdd/.

description.description: One-line human-readable description of the project.

issue.description: Optional free-string reference to an issue tracker entry (URL, Gitea ID, etc.).

creator.description: Who created and owns this project.

phase.description: Current FSM phase. Carries the full load for project state — no separate status field.

blocked.description: Whether the project is blocked. When true, blocked_reason should be set.

blocked_reason.description: Free-string explanation of why the project is blocked. Should be set when blocked=true.

task_index.description: Current task number (1-indexed). Only meaningful during IMPLEMENT phase. Null otherwise.

task_total.description: Total number of tasks in plan.md. Only meaningful during IMPLEMENT phase. Null otherwise.

claimed_by.description: Null when available. String agent name when someone is working on it.

claimed_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp with timezone. Null when unclaimed. Used for stale-claim detection.

created.description: ISO-8601 timestamp with timezone. When the project was created.

updated.description: ISO-8601 timestamp with timezone. Last modification time.
